Verify destination-specific controls (e.g., ITAR overlap, UN embargoes) and confirm no prohibited re-export to sanctioned countries.

raw.content_en: The US Department of Commerce (BIS) has rescinded the Biden-era firearms rule, restoring prior export control treatment for civilian firearms, ammunition, and parts. This reduces licensing burdens for certain semi-automatic firearms and related components previously captured by stricter controls. Exporters must still classify goods under the correct US HTS/ECCN, screen against the Entity List and denied party lists, and confirm end-user/end-use for any controlled items. Section 301 tariffs and FCC Part 15/18 requirements remain applicable for US-bound electronics and RF modules. Re-export and deemed export rules continue to apply to US-origin technology.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口管制规则，恢复对民用枪支、弹药及零部件的原有出口管制待遇。此举降低了此前受更严格管控的某些半自动枪支及相关部件的许可负担。出口商仍须按正确的美国HTS/ECCN进行归类，对照实体清单和被拒绝方名单进行筛查，并对任何受控物项确认最终用户和最终用途。对于输美电子产品和射频模块，301条款关税及FCC第15/18部分要求仍然适用。美国原产技术的再出口和视同出口规则继续有效。

Obtain and retain a signed non-transferable end-user certificate and end-use statement for controlled firearms and components.
Map HTS lines against Section 301 lists for tariff exposure and confirm FCC Part 15/18 IDs for any wireless electronics in the shipment.
If goods may be re-exported to the EU, prepare RoHS and REACH declarations and WEEE producer responsibility evidence.
Document whether the shipment qualifies for a license exception or No License Required; keep the determination memo on file.

raw.source: US BIS - Department of Commerce Rescinds Biden-Era Firearms Rule, Restoring Common Sense to Export Controls on Civilian Firearms
raw.content_en: The US Department of Commerce (BIS) has rescinded the Biden-era firearms rule, restoring prior export control treatment for civilian firearms, ammunition, and related parts under the EAR. This reduces licensing burdens for certain civilian firearm exports but does not eliminate all controls: items may still fall under the USML (ITAR) or EAR-controlled categories, and end-user/end-use restrictions, embargoed destinations, and Entity List screening remain mandatory. Exporters must re-verify ECCN classification, license exceptions, and destination-based prohibitions before shipment.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口规则，恢复了对民用枪支、弹药及相关零部件在《出口管理条例》（EAR）下的原有出口管制待遇。此举降低了部分民用枪支出口的许可负担，但并未取消全部管制：相关物项仍可能属于USML（ITAR）或EAR管制类别，最终用户/最终用途限制、禁运目的地及实体清单筛查仍为强制要求。出口商在发运前必须重新核实ECCN分类、许可例外及基于目的地的禁令。
